title: cyrtorhyncha cymbalaria subsp. alpina
intro: Cyrtorhyncha cymbalaria subsp. alpina, commonly known as the Alpine Marjoram or Alpine Thyme, is a subspecies of the Cymbalaria plant, belonging to the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and support digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Cyrtorhyncha cymbalaria subsp. alpina include its antiseptic and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe respiratory issues and calm digestive disturbances. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as thymol and carvacrol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
